videos.title: DON'T BE FOOLED Long OR Short, Here Are Your ARMWRESTLING OPTIONS!
videos.summary:
**DON'T BE FOOLED — LONG OR SHORT, HERE ARE YOUR ARMWRESTLING OPTIONS!**

One of the most important things to understand about my armwrestling lessons is that they are ALWAYS taught under one fundamental assumption:

**You and your opponent are equally developed physically.**

Equal strength. Equal conditioning. Equal levels of physical preparation.

Because when raw strength is no longer the deciding factor, **BIOMECHANICS BECOMES THE BATTLEGROUND.**

Armwrestling isn't simply about finding your strongest movement. It's about understanding the mechanical advantages and disadvantages created by your anatomy, your opponent's anatomy, and the positions you both occupy.

In this video, I break down the fundamental offensive and defensive options available to both LONG ARM and SHORT ARM armwrestlers.

We explore how differences in arm length influence the available lanes of attack, how to recognise biomechanical opportunities, and why the correct strategy is often very different from what your natural instincts suggest.

**The goal isn't to become stronger than your opponent. It's to create a situation where your strength is more effective than theirs.**

Whether you're the taller, longer-levered athlete or the shorter, more compact powerhouse, there are opportunities available to you.

The key is knowing what they are, when they exist, and how to exploit them.

**STOP THINKING ONLY ABOUT STRENGTH. START THINKING ABOUT BIOMECHANICAL ADVANTAGE.**
